system.description:
At 2nd level you learn how to use your wild shape ability to get into dangerous places, or out of them, by blending in. Rather than take on an animal form when you use @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-class-features.Item.3jdfihvtbyhbv9ez]{Wild Shape}, you can cast the @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.yav7747ibqje7nzm]{Alter Self} spell with the following changes:

When you choose the Altered State option, you can appear as another heritage which possesses up to 8 limbs or as few as none. When you take the form of a heritage with more limbs than you normally have, you only directly control up to your normal quantity, with the rest mirroring the movements of another similar limb.

Clambering Form: You may choose to gain a climb speed equal to your base Speed while keeping your hands free.

Wings: You may instead gain a fly speed equal to your base Speed without growing wings if you are in a Zero G environment.
